text:
Anna (CS): Heads up — Acme onboarding: they signed the SLOs yesterday but asked for clarity on how latency SLOs map to credits. Need a short explainer + evidence checklist for monthly reporting. Who can take point?
Priya (AM): I can do a one-pager. Need the exact contract language for credits — pinging @Jorge for legal confirmation.
Jorge (Legal): On it. Share the clause reference if you have it; otherwise I can pull the standard credit calc we usually use. Rough formula is (credited_minutes / total_minutes) * monthly_fee but will confirm thresholds.
Mike (SRE): Quick Q: what's the precise latency SLO? Acme is on Dedicated; their SLA in the contract was 99.5% uptime and p95 latency <= 450ms. Do we have p95 buckets tracked for their routes?
Sam (Onboarding): We enabled per-route metrics in their console, but not all customer routes are annotated. I can add tags if you give me the list of endpoints they use.
Anna (CS): List: /api/generate, /api/embeddings, /chat/v1. I'll DM the exact set with any aliases. Also need a sample evidence bundle for any future credit disputes (customer requested).
Priya (AM): For the one-pager, thinking of an 'evidence bundle' checklist: 1) time-windowed metrics export (CSV), 2) trace IDs for incidents, 3) sampling logs, 4) deployment/rollout notes, 5) customer's traffic pattern summary. Anything to add @Mike?
Mike (SRE): Add: config dump (model variant, quantization level, batching settings) and the server-side `batching/mtu` values; without those we can't reproduce perf. Also include the route-level p95 history for the billing window.
Jorge (Legal): Small note: avoid committing to a public-facing formula in the one-pager. Reference the contract clause and include an illustrative example for transparency. We'll provide redlined clause if needed.
Anna (CS): :thumbsup: Good call. Priya — can you draft the one-pager with a clear 'how we calculate credits' appendix showing an example but linking to the contract for the actual calculation?
Priya (AM): Yep. Also want to schedule a 30-min enablement session with their SREs to walk the reporting exports and the console. Preferences?
Sam (Onboarding): Thursday 10–11am PT works for me. I can run the console demo and show how to export CSVs and tag routes.
Mike (SRE): I can join for the p95 calculation and instrumentation piece. I'll prepare a tiny demo script we use to compute credits and a checklist of required signals.
Mike (SRE): ```python
# demo credit calc (illustrative only)
def calc_credit(downtime_mins, period_mins, monthly_fee):
    return (downtime_mins / period_mins) * monthly_fee
```
Anna (CS): Perfect. After the enablement we'll ship the one-pager + a downloadable 'evidence bundle template' and update the onboarding checklist. Note: this is a renewal risk item — customer flagged documentation clarity as a gating concern for their upcoming QBR. If we don't land this before their QBR, renewal risk increases. Aim for Friday EOD.
Priya (AM): Agreed. Plan: draft by EOD Wednesday, schedule demo for Thursday, collect signoff and upload final docs by Friday.
Jorge (Legal): I'll post the redlined credit clause by Wednesday morning and flag any language that might require change.
ops-bot: Incident export uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/acme/metrics/1795001200-1795004800.csv
Anna (CS): Thanks all. Action items recap: Priya — draft one-pager + schedule demo; Mike — script + config checklist; Sam — add route tags and demo exports; Jorge — legal clause; I'll own the customer comms and track signoff. @Priya please add the demo invite and share the draft when ready.
